claude_proposed_widenings.name: spawned_creature placement relative to item/source
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The existing spawned-creature surface only offers coarse `Range` values like `self`, `touch`, or a numeric point range. This item requires a deterministic nearest-valid-space placement rule relative to the censer, not a distance chosen by the user.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: "The elemental appears in an unoccupied space as close to the censer as possible."

claude_proposed_widenings.name: CreatureControl without invented command range
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The current `CreatureControl` record requires `commandRangeFeet`, but this item gives no numeric command range. Encoding one would invent a rule.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: CreatureControl with unspecified fallback behavior
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The current `CreatureControl` record requires `defaultBehavior`, but the item does not specify what the elemental does when uncommanded. Supplying `independent` or `dodge_and_avoid` would be a false rule addition.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: catalog_ref summoned-creature overrides for language comprehension
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The item deterministically changes what the summoned creature understands, but `catalog_ref` companions cannot currently carry a targeted override like `understandsCasterLanguages`.
